stories.title: Week 7: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 beats Young Love Hunters by 113.42, and Chubb So Big I Waddle loses by 1.70
stories.dek: The lowest team in the league got lapped and the 122.72 club got robbed. That's football.
body: Week 7 is final. Lemon Squeezy had the top score at 174.34 and is 6-1 with a 68-9 all-play record. Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 31.30, Drake Maye had 28.44 and Amon-Ra St. Brown had 25.20. Prepetente is the GOAT! lost its third straight with 94.22.

The blowout was Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 164.88 over Young Love Hunters 51.46, a 113.42-point margin. Tony Pollard had 36.50, Trey McBride had 27.10 and CeeDee Lamb had 24.40, and ChuckJ10 still left 113.72 on the bench. Young Love Hunters' 51.46 is the fourth-lowest score in league history, and it fell to 0-7 and 0-77 in all-play.

The bad beat goes to RobMeyers. Chubb So Big I Waddle scored 122.72 and lost 124.42 to I Believe in Love, a 1.70-point game. Tee Higgins had 28.80 and Caleb Williams had 23.12. Buccaneer51 left Bo Nix's 29.28 on the bench and still won, and 1.70 is the By a C-Hair payout. Buccaneer51 gets it.

Mean Machine hit 163.58 against Trevor Have I Ever's 81.10 and is 2-5 with the fourth-most points in the league. Etn her out lost 127.14 to 107.60 against 50 Shades of Rae, with Juwan Johnson (1.70) and Sam LaPorta (2.80) in the lineup. Bill_Buttlicker's five-game win streak is dead. He's 5-2, and the all-play record is 37-40.

stories.title: Lemon Squeezy is 6‑1, 68‑9 in all-play, and owns six firsts across three drafts
stories.dek: TotesMagoat scored 174.34 against a team that scored 94.22 and the league's real question is who gets the picks next.
body: Lemon Squeezy leads the league with 1228.46 points and has lost nine all-play games in seven weeks. That's the best all-play record in the league by 11 wins. 50 Shades of Rae is next at 57-20.
TotesMagoat won the title in 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2025, and lost the final in 2020 and 2023. superdog91 won the other three. Since 2019, those two have split all seven championships.

The dynasty part: TotesMagoat owns ten picks in the first three rounds of the 2027 draft, including his own first, G8rDuc's first and BertDirty's first, plus five seconds. He also owns ChuckJ10's 2028 first. Mean Machine is 2-5, so that BertDirty pick is an early first right now.
Week 8 he gets Trevor Have I Ever, a 5-2 team that's missing Lamar Jackson and Emeka Egbuka. Lemon Squeezy is a 44-point favorite (92 percent). Somebody stop him. Nobody will.

stories.title: Young Love Hunters is 0‑7, 0‑77 in all-play, and owns eight 2027 picks
stories.dek: BeatULikeABoss scored 51.46 and left Malik Willis' 27.02 on the bench.
body: Young Love Hunters has lost to every team in the league every week. It owns the lowest score in league history (43.58 in Week 3) and now the fourth-lowest too (51.46 in Week 7). It has scored 445.02 points in seven games, 63.6 a week.

Jordan Love had 16.96 in Week 7. Malik Willis had 27.02 and sat on the bench. In a one-QB league, that's a 10.06-point swing at one slot. Pierre Strong Jr., Jalen Royals, Ted Hurst III and Cade Otton combined for zero.

But this is a dynasty league. BeatULikeABoss owns his own 2027 first, Marco_Polo's, Buccaneer51's and superdog91's 2027 seconds, plus four thirds. He also owns Bill_Buttlicker's and G8rDuc's 2028 seconds. His top-ten core averages 24.2 years old, the youngest in the league.

Plot twist: Thursday night, Jordan Love went for 22.52 and the Packers D added 12.00, so Young Love Hunters has 34.72 with Hurts So Good still at 0. The 0-7 team is leading a game. Don't get used to it.
Week 8 he draws Hurts So Good, a 4-3 team that's a 98 percent favorite. Enjoy the 1.1 overall pick, buddy. You're earning it.

stories.title: Update: who's winning the CeeDee Lamb trade after seven weeks?
stories.dek: Bill_Buttlicker sent CeeDee Lamb to ChuckJ10 for George Pickens and ChuckJ10's 2027 first. ChuckJ10 named his team after it.
body: On May 24, Bill_Buttlicker traded CeeDee Lamb to ChuckJ10 for George Pickens and ChuckJ10's 2027 first-round pick. Through seven weeks, Lamb has 157.5 fantasy points and Pickens has 98.5. On the field, ChuckJ10 is winning by 59 points.

The standings say it's closer. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is 4-3 with 1094.82 points, third in the league. It also has the second-most points against in the league (1008.44). Etn her out is 5-2. The 2027 first would be a mid-round pick if the season ended today, and Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is playing Etn her out in Week 8.
The roster is aging. Dak Prescott is 33 and Davante Adams is 33 and on IR for 6-10 weeks. ChuckJ10 owns one first in the next three drafts, his own 2029. Bill_Buttlicker has the 2027 first.

Verdict: Lamb is the better player and the ship is 4-3. If it misses the playoffs, Bill_Buttlicker gets a high first for free. If it doesn't, the trade is even. Week 8 decides some of it: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is a 32-point favorite at 85 percent.

rumors.t: TotesMagoat's 68-9 all-play record has been submitted to the county as evidence that the other eleven teams are, technically, a charity.
superdog91's Cade Klubnik, who cost $602 of FAAB and has scored 0.0 points, has asked the taxi squad for a ride to the stadium. The taxi squad is a stationary list.
RobMeyers has requested a recount of the 1.70 points. The league office has told him the points are not up for a vote, but he is welcome to take it up with the Sleeper API.
BeatULikeABoss has scheduled a press conference to announce a plan to score 52 points in Week 8. The plan has a footnote that says 'or 51.'
G8rDuc still doesn't own a 2027 pick in the first three rounds and is now asking whether 2031 picks can be 'sort of' bought on layaway.
Buccaneer51 left Bo Nix's 29.28 on the bench and won by 1.70, and is now being studied by a team of mathematicians who describe it as 'the least deserved win in the Western Hemisphere.'
Trevor Have I Ever has reportedly asked the league office whether 63.10 points on a Thursday night counts as a full week and whether Lemon Squeezy can just forfeit out of respect.

RobMeyers has the oldest core in the league and Higgins (27, 104.1 points, 28.80 last week) is his best trade chip. superdog91 has four firsts to protect and a spare second to spend on a receiver.

Hurts is out for the year and Tyler Shough scored 14.82 in Week 7. Buccaneer51 has Jared Goff, Matthew Stafford and Nix (29.28 on the bench), so one of the three is surplus. A 26-year-old QB for a second is fair.
RedDevil904 has no 2027 picks but his 2028 second is intact, and Emeka Egbuka is out. Williams has 84.7 points, and ChuckJ10 has one first in three drafts and needs picks.
BeatULikeABoss sends his own 2027 first, the one that might be the 1.1 overall pick, to the guy who already owns six firsts for a taxi running back with 10.7 points. The empire grows.

columns.title: TREVOR HAVE I EVER HAS 63.10 BEFORE LEMON SQUEEZY EVEN WOKE UP

body: 63.10 POINTS! CHUBA HUBBARD HAD 24.90! MATTHEW GOLDEN HAD 20.90! TUCKER KRAFT HAD 17.30! THAT'S RedDevil904 SIX HOURS INTO THE WEEK AND TOTESMAGOAT HAS ZERO ON THE BOARD!
LEMON SQUEEZY IS A 44‑POINT FAVORITE AND I DON'T CARE! THEY PLAYED THE MAN WITHOUT LAMAR JACKSON AND HE'S UP 63.10 TO NOTHING! I WANT TO SEE A SUNDAY! I NEED TO SEE A SUNDAY!

columns.title: Young Love Hunters is leading a game, and it still isn't good
columns.dek: Jordan Love hit 22.52 and the Packers defense added 12.00.
body: Look, I'll give credit. Young Love Hunters has 34.72 and Hurts So Good has nothing yet. BeatULikeABoss got 22.52 from Jordan Love and 12.00 from the Packers D, and it took Thursday night to do it.

But this team is 0‑7 and has scored 445.02 points all year, 63.6 a week. One good Thursday doesn't fix a roster. Pierre Strong Jr. gave him 0.20. Sunday is when the football gets real, and Hurts So Good has the whole week left to start people.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Five Lineup Moves That Can't Miss
columns.dek: I've been doing this for a long time. Some of it has been in this league.
body: 1. Start every tight end you own. Bill_Buttlicker started three in Week 7 and they scored 19.30 combined. That's called diversification.
2. Bench the quarterback who's about to score 27.02. BeatULikeABoss did it with Malik Willis, and the team lost by 113.42. Obviously the quarterback was the problem.
3. Drop a receiver after a bad stretch. Bill_Buttlicker dropped Darnell Mooney on Oct. 25, and if it works for the commissioner it'll work for you.
4. Pay $602 for a quarterback and put him on the taxi squad. superdog91 did it with Cade Klubnik, who has 0.0 points, and superdog91 is 5-2. Correlation is causation.
5. Win by 1.70 and tell everyone you're a genius. Buccaneer51 did it. He left Bo Nix's 29.28 on the bench the whole time.

columns.title: Mean Machine is losing to itself, and my model has a name for it
columns.dek: A 43‑34 all-play record, 163.58 points, 2‑5, and a tight end.
body: Mean Machine scored 163.58 in Week 7. It's 2-5. By my 'Expected Wins' metric, which is just the all-play record (43-34) divided by 77 and multiplied by 7, BertDirty should be 3.9-3.1. He's two wins short, which my model calls 'schedule gravity.'

Pat Freiermuth started at tight end for 4.00 and Mason Taylor scored 26.20 on the bench. That's a 22.20-point gap, or 13.6 percent of the week's total. Every percentage point means a different thing, and none of them mean anything.
BertDirty's 2027 first belongs to TotesMagoat, so my model has concluded that the optimal number of wins is 'enough to look busy.' Please don't check my math.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 7 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,676 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,785.8 to 527.5. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 939.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,460.6 points. The picks have given 2,756.3.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,562.1 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,759.8. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,190.5 points since. Marshall has 155.8.

th.curNote: Trades made in 2026, before and during the season. Too early to grade. Hindsight comes next year.
